incidents.title: Senator Cardin targeted by deepfake of Ukraine's ex-foreign minister
incidents.targets: US Senate Foreign Relations Chair Ben Cardin
incidents.outcome: Call ended when the fake began pressing on long-range missiles; State Dept confirmed it was not Kuleba. FBI investigating.
incidents.confidenceReason: Cardin's statement, quoted verbatim by NBC, says only that the caller was "posing as a known individual"; the Senate notice says the call "appeared to be a live audio-video connection". Neither party says AI or deepfake; that word is NBC's and Punchbowl's. An AI claim reported only second-hand is Suspected.
incidents.summary: Cardin's office joined a Zoom with a live audio-video likeness of Dmytro Kuleba that began asking out-of-character political questions. Russia was suspected by briefed people.
incidents.quote: Sen. Ben Cardin says he was targeted by apparent deepfake call
incidents.singleSourceReason: Only NBC News has reported this operation among the sources found in the 2026-11-17 sweep.

harness.note: Deepfake/impersonation tool only, no agent harness
